entries.en: there is no cause; for no reason
there is no cause or origin; for no reason at all
there is no road to come by; there is no way to go
entries.notes: L 栏后半 ne da vida 讹误难解，依 H/M 栏「无路来」立意。

entries.en: there is no way to go; nowhere left to turn
entries.notes: L 栏 fanela vida 讹误，依 H/M 栏「无路去」立意。

entries.en: not much; not many; (no ha mucho) not long ago
not so much; not so many
entries.notes: H 栏「向」于义不合，疑为「偌」之借写，M 栏 hiô 与之相涉。

entries.en: there is no principal; no capital

entries.zh: 没有别的缘故；没有别的事情
entries.en: there is no other cause; no other business
there is nothing but this one

entries.zh: 连一个里亚尔也没有；分文不名
entries.en: not a single real (coin) to be had; penniless
entries.notes: H 栏「欠一件白白个」与 L 栏字面不密合，仅「分文不名」大意可通，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 无从推托；找不到门路推卸
entries.en: there is no way to excuse it; no way out of it

entries.zh: 无人能通行；道路断绝行人
entries.en: no one can pass; the way is closed to travelers
entries.notes: M 栏首音节 T99 污损，L 栏 pase por dormido 语义迂曲，释义存疑。

entries.en: there are no tracks or footprints; no trace remains
entries.notes: M 栏首音节 T99 污损，H 栏「蹄/即」存疑，L 栏 fuenga 讹误，释义存疑。

entries.en: there is nothing to eat; an empty mouth

entries.zh: 没有别的可吃，只有白饭；再无米饭
entries.en: there is no more cooked rice; nothing but plain rice
entries.notes: morisqueta 为菲岛西语「米饭」，非西班牙本土词汇。

entries.en: to eat plain rice without viands
entries.notes: 「白食」可兼指白饭无菜与白吃，此处依 morisqueta（米饭）取前义。

entries.en: there is no profit or benefit; utterly useless
there is no peace; all is peril and disorder
there is no peace; unsettled and unsafe
entries.notes: R 栏作西语 no(y) seguro（不安全），非官话对音，可与 H 栏互证。

entries.en: to have nothing in hand; not a single thing
entries.notes: L 栏 no cojer mos caconlamano 讹误难通，M 栏首音残缺（T99），依 H 栏「无一物」立义。

entries.zh: 久不进食也能挨；禁得住饿
entries.en: to go a long time without eating and suffer no harm; to endure hunger
entries.notes: H 栏「金」疑为「禁」之借字，L 栏 sele hacer dematra 讹误，依「禁饿」立义。

entries.en: do not conjecture; do not guess
entries.notes: H 栏首字残缺，M 栏 púr 无字可对，仅 L 栏 no coniecturar 义可据。
